verdict.rationale: Rive's first-party docs say the Rive Editor connects to AI tools through MCP. The MCP tools let an AI create View Models, State Machines, Layouts and Shapes, and a probe confirms an official MCP server is documented. Rive is a design/animation platform, not an agent itself, so the server axis applies and this is the product's own capability. Missing for 10: detailed setup/configuration and supported-client documentation, a full tool catalog beyond the 'first set of tools', independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: You can connect the Rive Editor to AI tools through MCP (Model Context Protocol).
The first set of tools are designed to let AI handle repetitive tasks, like creating complex View Models, State Machines with hundreds of states/layers, Layouts, Shapes, and more.
official MCP server documented at https://rive.app/docs/editor/ai/mcp
